 Riyadh’s financial centre was rocked by Houthi missile fire as the conflict leaves ‘lasting mark’ on global energy.

 Saudi-led coalition forces have intercepted multiple Houthi missiles, marking the second night the Gulf country has faced attacks after a skyscraper in Riyadh’s business district was damaged yesterday.
 The Houthi health ministry says attacks on Yemen’s capital, Sanaa, have killed 10 people over the past two days as the internationally recognised Yemeni government and the Saudi-led coalition trade fire with the Iran-backed rebel group.
